puzzleText:
In what year did US Navy codebreakers in Hawaii decipher the Japanese Navy's Fleet General Purpose Code, which gave them a decisive advantage in the Battle of Midway - the most pivotal naval battle of World War II?

To answer this question, follow the flow chart below for each number between 1-9.

[[ASCII]]
                      +--------------------------------+
                      | Is the number odd or even?     |
                      +--------------------------------+
                           /                    \
                          /                      \
                     Odd /                        \ Even
                        /                          \
     +------------------------------+        +----------------------------+
     |       Is it prime?           |        |       Is it prime?         |
     +------------------------------+        +----------------------------+
       /               \                           /                 \  
    Yes                No                         No                 Yes
     |                  |                         |                   |       
   [STOP]      +--------------------+     +--------------------+      | 
               |   Is it a cube?    |     |   Is it square?    |      |
               +--------------------+     +--------------------+      |
                 /            \                  /         \          |
              Yes             No               Yes         No         |
                |              |                |           |         |
         +-----------+   +-----------+   +-----------+    [STOP]   +-----------+
         | 1st Digit |   | 2nd Digit |   | 3rd Digit |             | 4th Digit |
         +-----------+   +-----------+   +-----------+             +-----------+
[[/ASCII]]
hint:
List of prime numbers: 2, 3, 5, 7.
List of square numbers: 1, 4, 9.
List of cube numbers: 1, 8.
title: Cracking The Code Is Half The Battle
